c_status: All 52 definitions are present: 50 ordinary C procedures and 2 with short AH register-ABI bridges. The full sound C compiler profile is unproven.
independent_recovery: ADLIB.C/H were reconstructed from the executable and decompiler reference before the following corroborating source was discovered.

corroborating_source.description: Primary ScummVM CVS commit dated 19 December 2001: AdlibSoundDriver reconstruction, iMUSE synthesis tables and algorithms.
agreements: The 16-entry parameter-selector map matches the executable exactly.
The 32-entry envelope duration table matches the executable exactly.
Register-field masks, OPL operator mappings, 34-byte envelope and 8-byte work layouts correspond.
The byte LFSR uses the same 0xB8 feedback constant and initial seed 1.
The timer returns immediately after expiring one voice; this unusual behavior is shared.
corroborating_source.limitations: These matches establish close algorithmic ancestry, not an exact historical source text, compiler version, vendor license, or game-specific binary provenance. No ScummVM source text is copied into ADLIB.C.

c_semantic_verification.scope: One compiled procedure with original callees; sampled states, not all branches or full compiled integration.
